name: GlobalSecureAccessCustomBlockPage
label: Manage the custom block page
helpText: Sets the message users see when Global Secure Access blocks a website. Supports limited markdown, including links like [Contact the help desk](https://example.com). Set the state to Disabled to use Microsoft's default block page. Requires 'Onboard Global Secure Access' first and an Entra Internet Access license.
executiveText: Controls what staff see when the company's network security service blocks a website: a company message with who to contact, or Microsoft's default page.
docsDescription: Checks the custom block page state and message live, and writes both through the documented settings PATCH. Disabled grades the state alone; an enabled page needs a message.

blockMessage.label: Block page message (markdown, links like [Help](https://example.com) allowed)
